nabh_chapter_name: Access Assessment and Continuity of Care
standard_description: Patients are screened and their care needs assessed at point of entry
gap_area: Triage documentation incomplete for walk-in patients; no formal triage scale in use

nabh_chapter_name: Access Assessment and Continuity of Care
standard_description: Initial assessment of inpatients completed within 24 hours by appropriate clinician
gap_area: Ward round assessment times recorded inconsistently; 11 AM average vs 8 AM target

nabh_chapter_name: Access Assessment and Continuity of Care
standard_description: Medication reconciliation conducted at admission and discharge
gap_area: Discharge medication reconciliation checklist completion rate 61%

nabh_chapter_name: Access Assessment and Continuity of Care
standard_description: Discharge planning initiated within 24 hours of admission
gap_area: Discharge plan documented in 74% of records; target 100%

standard_description: Nursing care plans documented and updated daily for all inpatients
gap_area: Care plan updates inconsistent on night shifts; agency nurses document less reliably

standard_description: Pre-operative patient assessment and consent completed per protocol
gap_area: Pre-op checklists incomplete in 18% of OT cases; patient pre-op readiness flag FALSE in 14 sessions

standard_description: ICU patient monitoring and step-down protocol followed
gap_area: Step-down criteria not consistently documented; avg delay 14.3 hrs after clinical readiness

standard_description: Infection control protocols followed for all patient care activities
gap_area: HAI rate 4.2/100 admissions; hypochlorite stockouts on 7 days; glove compliance gap

standard_description: Patient fall prevention measures in place and documented
gap_area: Fall risk assessments completed; 2 falls recorded in Feb; one minor injury

standard_description: Formulary maintained, approved, and accessible to all clinical staff
gap_area: Formulary list available; 3 non-formulary drugs dispensed without documented justification

standard_description: High-alert medications stored separately with double-check protocol
gap_area: High-alert storage labelling non-compliant in ICU satellite pharmacy on 4 occasions

standard_description: PRN medication orders countersigned by permanent nurse per protocol
gap_area: Agency nurse PRN orders countersigned by permanent nurse in only 48% of cases; target 100%

standard_description: Medication reconciliation at discharge with patient counselling
gap_area: Discharge counselling documented in 72% of cases; pharmacy clearance avg 2.1 hrs after order

standard_description: Vacancy positions filled within 60 days of arising
gap_area: 16 nursing vacancies; 3 positions open >90 days; no formal recruitment SLA in place

standard_description: New staff undergo documented orientation before independent duty
gap_area: Permanent nurse orientation documented; agency nurse protocol orientation done in 73% of shifts

standard_description: Annual competency assessments conducted for all clinical staff
gap_area: Annual competency for permanent staff done; no formal competency framework for agency staff

standard_description: Staff to patient ratios maintained per department benchmarks
gap_area: ICU ratio 1:1.8 (agency-supplemented); ward ratio 1:6.2; both within limits but dependent on agency

standard_description: Biomedical equipment preventive maintenance schedule adhered to
gap_area: PM schedule adherence 58%; 6 equipment failures during February; 3 with OT impact

standard_description: Medical gas supply (oxygen, nitrous oxide) continuously monitored
gap_area: Piped oxygen supply functional; 2 cylinder backup changeovers required due to supplier delay

standard_description: CSSD sterilisation processes validated and records maintained
gap_area: CSSD avg TAT 87 min vs 45 min target; autoclave validation records incomplete for 4 cycles

standard_description: Fire safety drills and emergency preparedness conducted
gap_area: Fire drill conducted Jan 2024; emergency evacuation plan posted; minor gaps in documentation

standard_description: Patient satisfaction surveys collected and results reviewed monthly
gap_area: Survey response rate 31% vs 35% target; results reviewed at departmental meeting

standard_description: Adverse events and near-misses reported and root-cause analysed
gap_area: HAI events documented; 3 of 12 HAI events had formal RCA completed; others informal review only

standard_description: Readmission rate monitored and causally analysed each month
gap_area: Readmission rate 5%; RCA conducted for 6 of 14 readmissions; TPA rejection on 4

standard_description: OT utilisation and cancellation root cause reviewed monthly
gap_area: OT cancellation rate 17.3%; cancellation RCA conducted; equipment and scheduling causes identified

standard_description: Correct patient identification using two identifiers at every interaction
gap_area: Two-ID check used in 92% of observed interactions; gaps in OPD

standard_description: Safe surgery checklist (WHO SSC) completed for all OT procedures
gap_area: SSC completed and signed in 86% of OT sessions; missing in 14% (agency nurse as team member)

standard_description: Hand hygiene compliance rate at or above 80% for all clinical areas
gap_area: Hand hygiene compliance 68% overall; ICU 74%; wards 62%; correlation with HAI events noted
